title: The Wax Age
description: This project adds more functions to wax by making it wax wood
body:
# welcome to the mod WCWW!

## what does this mod do?
This mod adds new feature to the honeycomb that lets it be more useful!

## what features does it add?
This mod adds lot of honeycomb features including : 
- multi-waxing 
- multi-unwaxing
- waxing anything forever whit new item

## what hapens when you wax stuff
- The wood/planks become unignitable
- Corals become alive forever!
- and lot more!
